status: Illustrative assumptions, not observed market estimates
currency: Normalized USD per 100 USD initially invested
conventions: All monetary amounts are in constant purchasing-power dollars. Rental-price changes and the required return are real rates; inflation is not modeled.
One investment cycle; capital paid at time zero, operating cash flows at each year end.
Utilization stays constant within each scenario. Gross revenue follows the rental price path, while real operating costs stay constant.
The owner may retire early. Choose the operating duration that minimizes required utilization, subject to the maximum productive life.
No interim replacement investment. Full capital recovery is required before retirement, with no terminal value.
Pre-tax, unlevered cash flows. The discount rate is a required return, not a loan interest rate.
Identical initial economics isolate asset duration; these are not calibrated GPU, property, grid-access, or power-generation returns.
